title: Southfields Duplex
meta_description: Southfields Duplex is a stylish 6BR, 5BA duplex with a pool, tiki bar, and prime west end location---just minutes from the beach, Pier Park, and 30A.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Southfields Duplex, a stylish six-bedroom, five-bathroom coastal compound just minutes from the sugar-white sands and emerald waters of Panama City Beach. Located on the peaceful west end, this connected duplex offers the perfect setup for families or groups traveling together---with separate interiors for added privacy and a sprawling shared backyard made for memory-making.

Together, the homes feature two full kitchens, two spacious living areas, and enough room to dine, relax, and recharge with ease. Each side includes a king bedroom, queen bedroom, and a twin-over-twin bunk room---plus five bathrooms total, three of which are ensuite for ultimate comfort and convenience.

Step outside to discover your own slice of paradise: a shimmering pool, shaded al fresco dining space, tiki bar, loungers, and lush lawn where the whole crew can gather under the palms. Whether you're enjoying morning coffee in the breeze or cocktails by the pool, this backyard is built for bliss.

Beach days are a breeze with public beach access #87 just a five-minute stroll away. And when you're ready to explore, you're within easy reach of Pier Park's shops and restaurants, the natural beauty of 30A, and the laid-back charm of Laguna Beach.

With space to spread out and all the comforts of home---plus one seriously epic backyard---Southfields Duplex offers the ultimate group getaway on the Emerald Coast.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Pool alarm installed on all doors leading to the enclosed backyard.

Parking Details:
- The driveway accommodates 7 vehicles.
- No street parking.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
